meta.title: HarmonyOS device tools
meta.description: Drives a HarmonyOS device over hdc from the conversation. The device panel offers a live picture, screenshots, and screen recording; in the conversation, screen capture returns the image itself, with touch input, UI hierarchy dumps, app install and launch, hilog reads, file transfer, and recording as separate tools. This HarmonyOS line ships no screenrecord command, so the picture and recordings are built from sequential frame captures and run at a few frames per second; a recording becomes an mp4, or keeps its frame sequence when ffmpeg is unavailable. Every tool finds the hdc client and the attached device on its own; the screenshot tool needs an image-capable model, and calls act on a real device immediately, so treat a tap or an install as a real change. Set hdcPath when hdc is not in the default location.
